name: Brumo
tagline: The operating system for cold-plunge studios that refuse to run on spreadsheets and vibes.
positioning: Brumo runs bookings, water-temp compliance, and membership billing across every cold-plunge location, so your ops team stops freezing over paperwork.

hero.h1: Run every plunge like you actually own the ice.
hero.sub: Brumo is the ops layer for multi-site cold-plunge studios: real-time water logs, per-session billing, and membership that reconciles itself. No clipboards. No 43°F guesswork.

features.title: Water logs that pass audits
features.description: Automatic temperature, pH, and sanitation capture per tub, timestamped and export-ready. Your health inspector gets a PDF instead of a hunch.

features.title: Per-plunge billing, done
features.description: Every session meters itself and rolls into one invoice. Corporate wellness contracts, drop-ins, and packages reconcile without a finance intern crying.

features.title: One dashboard, every site
features.description: Roll up 3 studios or 90. Occupancy, tub downtime, and no-show rates live on one screen instead of eleven group chats.

features.title: Booking that respects capacity
features.description: Slot limits per tub, buffer windows for turnover, and waitlists that auto-promote. Nobody shows up to a full plunge and a shrug.

features.title: Downtime alerts before members notice
features.description: Chiller drift, filter cycles, and drained tubs ping ops the moment a reading goes sideways — not after the 6am cohort complains.

features.title: Enterprise access, cleanly scoped
features.description: SSO, role-based permissions, and regional managers who only see their region. SOC 2 covered so procurement stops emailing you.

testimonials.quote: We went from three spreadsheets and a group text to one Brumo dashboard across nine studios. Reconciling corporate wellness invoices used to eat a full week. Now it's a Tuesday morning.
testimonials.name: Dana Reisinger

testimonials.quote: The water-log exports alone saved our expansion. Two counties, two inspectors, zero improvised paperwork. Brumo made compliance boring, which is the highest compliment I have.
testimonials.name: Marcus Vela

testimonials.quote: Usage-based pricing means we stop paying for tubs that sit idle in January. Finance finally understands our cost per plunge without a decoder ring.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For one studio ready to retire the clipboard for good.
For growing chains that need one source of cold truth.
For franchises and wellness networks at national scale.

homepage.footerBlurb: Brumo keeps cold-plunge studios cold, compliant, and paid. Built for operators who'd rather run the business than the paperwork.
